properties.context: Supersedes the merge-based ontology-spec-main plan before it reached any remote: rebase the branch onto main so the full implementation tree is present, then launch the port of the Kotlin/Go/TS implementation to the ontology spec. Constraints from the spec lead: SDK public APIs stay the same to the largest extent possible (extensions the named exception), and each named extension gets its own folder/file while shipping in the main SDK. All local.
properties.destination: ontology-spec-v1-jsonschema is rebased linearly onto main with both trees coexisting and validation green; the strategy reversal, the API-stability constraint, the schema source of truth, the port sequencing, and the extension packaging are recorded as ADR-0002 through ADR-0005; everything local, remote untouched.
out_of_scope: Every remote operation (push, PR, GitHub settings, remote branch rename)
The actual port implementation tracks (charted next, per ADR-0004)
The local rename of the branch to main (endgame, after the port tracks)
Accepting the Proposed ADRs (the spec lead reviews them)
